run_tracking_error_amass: run the main function to compute humanoid trajectory tracking error for an AMASS dataset
run_tracking_error_hdmi: run the main function to compute tracking error including object metrics for an HDMI dataset
run_tracking_error_custom: run the main function with custom dataset_dir, robot_type, task, and data_id arguments
review_tracking_error_output: review the printed tracking error metrics for position, orientation, and joint angles
summarize_tracking_error_metrics: summarize the mean position error, quaternion error, and joint angle error from trajectory data
